## Summary

Describe the change directly.

## Spec

Link the spec path for non-trivial changes.

Examples:

- `specs/my-feature/spec.md`
- `N/A (small change)`

## Constitution

- [ ] This change complies with `docs/constitution.md`

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:run`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (if behavior changed)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria verified against the spec

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay attention to.
